meta.name: brand-research
meta.description: Kickoff research for a brand you haven't worked on before — web research, existing-ad analysis from the Meta Ad Library, editorial-grammar profiling, sourced + AI-generated brand assets, hook/CTA libraries, and an ad concept brief. Produces one reusable brand-context pack (brand-summary, visual-identity, competitors, audience, existing-ads, brand-grammar, an asset manifest, and a concept brief) in a single pass. Use when starting on a brand the workspace hasn't touched.
